column1: # doc-lint pattern table.  code <TAB> group <TAB> regex <TAB> message
# A rule change is a data edit here, not a script edit. Every code maps to a numbered rule in
# commands/_shared/document-standard.md, and tests/unit/document-standard.bats asserts that mapping —
# a check with no written rule behind it is an unaccountable check.
# group: history | process | reference | contract-only, all skipped for record-class documents.
# Keep every regex narrow enough that a hit is wrong under any reading. Precision is the whole
# product: a linter that fires on legitimate work gets switched off and then enforces nothing.
# rule 5 — write the current truth
HIST1
column4: revision history in a contract document — move it to the record sidecar (git already holds history)

column1: HIST2
column4: a versioned section heading — keep only the current state

column1: HIST3
column4: struck-through text — delete the superseded state instead of marking it

column1: HIST4
column4: a superseded-state marker — delete the old state and write only the current one

column1: HIST5
column4: what an earlier version got wrong is history — state the current rule instead

column1: HIST6
column4: a discovery anecdote — keep the resulting requirement, drop the story

column1: HIST7
column3: \b(used to be|as it (used to|once) did|in the (previous|earlier) (pass|round|revision|version))\b
column4: a comparison with a past state — write only what is true now

column1: HIST8
column4: a draft-stage heading — a contract document carries the current state only

column1: # rule 7 — no process inside a contract document
PROC1
column4: panel process inside a contract document — it belongs in the record sidecar

column1: PROC2
column4: agent activity is not part of the contract — keep only the resulting requirement

column1: PROC3
column4: a count of agents run — state the resulting fact instead

column1: PROC4
column4: convergence status is process state — record it in the sidecar

column1: PROC5
column4: panel severity vocabulary — translate it into the requirement it produced

column1: PROC6
column4: panel metrics belong in the record sidecar

column1: PROC7
column3: \b([Nn]amed as a decision|stated explicitly rather than implied|for the record|worth flagging here|[Nn]oted rather than|[Ss]tated here rather than)\b
column4: a remark about this document's own act of writing — state the decision, not that you are stating it

column1: # rule 10 — references resolve; rule 3 — say it once
REF1
column4: an unresolvable reference — give the path and one line on why it matters here

column1: REF2
column4: a back-reference to your own text — say it once, in one place

column1: REF3
column3: \b(in other words|to clarify|to put it another way|that is to say)\b
column4: an explanation of your explanation — keep one version

column1: # Structural checks — emitted by bin/doc-lint.sh itself, not matched from this table. They are
# registered here because this file is where a code is looked up, and a check whose rule nobody can
# find is a check nobody can learn from. tests/unit/document-standard.bats asserts the mapping.
#   SIZE1  -> rule 1   the file crossed its type's line cap
#   INDEX1 -> rule 1   an _index.md costs more to load than the documents it lists
#   INDEX2 -> rule 1   an index row outgrew its one-line-rule column
#   INDEX3 -> rule 1   an index row's scope is not a value VAULT.md declares
#   LONG1  -> rule 3   a sentence past the 25/30-word ceiling
#   DUP1   -> rule 6   the same line defined in more than one place
#   PLAN1  -> rule 8   an artifact-lifecycle row with an empty cell
#   PLAN2  -> rule 8   a plan whose work items create files and which carries no lifecycle table
# PLAN1/PLAN2 apply rule 8 to a plan's artifacts: an item is executable only when its consumer is
# named. For everything a plan creates, `## Artifact lifecycles` records who asks for it, who writes
# it, who reads it, and what happens when it is absent or malformed — or one `none` row plus the
# reason. Plans record who writes a thing by habit and fail at the two ends: a binding nothing asks
# for, a report no seat is obliged to read. The form and its comment live in templates/plan.md.
